title: Northgate Optical Lab Logistics: Shipping Handling on Frames Returned to Stock
content:
A Northgate Optical frame that travelled to the lab with special lenses carries a lab shipping handling amount when it comes back to stock from an in-lab cancellation.

**Note.** Where both a lens material upgrade charge and a lens option charge (a light-adaptive, blue-light filtering or anti-reflective coating charge) were posted on the job, the frame has travelled to the lab with special lenses and a lab shipping handling amount of 6.00 is kept; where exactly one of the two was posted, the lab shipping handling amount is 3.00. Where neither was posted, no lab shipping handling amount is kept.

**Records read.** The charge entries posted on the eyewear job: a material upgrade charge, and any light-adaptive, blue-light filtering or anti-reflective coating charge. A charge counts as posted whether or not a credit has since been posted against it.

| Material upgrade charge posted | Lens option charge posted | Lab shipping handling amount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 6.00 |
| yes | no | 3.00 |
| no | yes | 3.00 |
| no | no | none |

## Examples (hypothetical jobs)

- Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses in polycarbonate with blue-light filtering: both posted, 6.00.
- Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses in standard plastic with no option charge on the job: neither posted, none.
- Northgate Single Vision Lenses in 1.67 high index with no option: one posted, 3.00.
